purpose: Make existing N0TE memory genuinely retained and consultable on the normal Song journey by composing canonical Evidence, imported context, Sessions, Learning, Success, Friction, Skill and Activity history into one read-only retention brief/context packet without creating a second memory store, silently promoting notes, inventing causality or granting action authority.

lineage.outcome: The artist can leave a Song, return, and have N0TE truthfully consult what was tried, what was learned, what remains uncertain, what repeatedly got in the way, what durable facts are still active and what to do next without reconstructing the history by hand.
lineage.capability: Canonical Song retention and selective memory consultation

why_now: The artist explicitly requested retention after the existing memory primitives had become consumer reachable in isolation. The high-leverage gap is no longer another memory table; it is a single truthful consult/use boundary that composes the already-landed memories and preserves their distinct authority, provenance and uncertainty semantics across quit/relaunch.
completion_proof: HeadquartersMemory exposes one SongRetentionService that owns no persistence and reads only the canonical LineageStore-backed memories
retention returns active Artist/Song/current-Version Evidence claims only while superseded claims remain historical and are not presented as current durable facts
retention preserves source class, confidence and Twin domain for durable facts without exposing internal claim/source-reference IDs
all recorded Song Sessions are consultable with objective, captured items, debrief and next action, preserving the latest continuation thread across quit/relaunch
all Song Learning episodes remain explicit change -> observation -> decision history with conditions, confounders, source posture and confidence preserved
Success patterns remain ASSOCIATION_ONLY with humility state and counterevidence semantics intact; no retained result becomes an automatic causal rule
Friction observations remain explicit; recurring status is surfaced only when canonical FrictionMemory finds the same blocker key across at least two distinct Sessions
Skill state is consulted from canonical SkillMemory and is never inferred from Session prose, Learning decisions or Friction
IMPORTED/SYNCED context remains evidence-only and consultable without acquiring observation or action authority
the retention context packet is JSON-safe, supports bounded section selection and omits internal Song/Session/Learning/claim/source-reference identities
retention reads are durable-pure and produce zero canonical database writes
the normal Song page exposes What N0TE remembers with current thread, next action, active durable facts, recurring blocker summary, Skill context and imported-context count
consumer retention markup does not leak profile, Session, Learning, claim or source-reference identifiers
quit/relaunch returns the same retained context packet and next action from canonical local memory
remembering remains read-only and grants no DAW/provider/action authority
full regression and staged consumer smoke execute on Ubuntu, Windows and macOS at the exact final head before merge evidence is claimed
review_repairs: retention was built on the repaired 76b09bfb interaction-depth lineage rather than spawning from stale main, preserving the valid prior UX work and the previously restored instance-lease changes
no retention table, database or duplicate Song model was introduced; the new service is a pure composition/read boundary
durable current facts use EvidenceMemory active-claim/supersession semantics rather than latest-row guessing
the model-facing context packet strips opaque lineage IDs and source references while retaining semantic source/confidence information
selective section retrieval was added so future coproducer use does not require dumping every retained category into every request
consumer presentation summarizes the combined retained thread without replacing the detailed Learning, Success, Friction and Activity surfaces already present
lazy shell installation is idempotent and happens only after package import through Headquarters construction, avoiding a consumer_shell/memory import cycle
